instruction: Use the pinned Desktop workflow only: Revit 2025, Archicad 27 build 6000 or newer, OpenStudio 3.10.0, and EnergyPlus 25.1.0. In this image, the installed entry points are `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`, `C:\Program Files\GRAPHISOFT\Archicad 27\Archicad.exe`, and `C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe`. Starting from init.ifc and workflow_spec.json, run run_revit_stage.ps1, run_archicad_stage.ps1, and run_openstudio_stage.ps1 in exact order. Do not hand-author delivered IFC, OSM, IDF, SQL, JSON, or CSV. Revit must preserve the seed's actual workshop structure: six columns and their layout, four exterior walls, the slab and their GlobalIds (the seed contains no IfcGrid entities and none should be invented). Replace the original single Room with native geometric Rooms for MAKER-WORKSHOP, OFFICE and TOOL-ROOM separated by room-boundary lines, and export stage1.ifc plus revit_handoff.json using the actual Revit-generated space GlobalIds. Archicad must import stage1.ifc using the supplied IFC4 translator, retain every upstream IfcRoot GlobalId, validate the live structural counts, equipment intensity, exposure, the actual native space-boundary state without fabricating absent relation types, and energy handoff properties, then export stage2.ifc, archicad_validation_report.json, and archicad_handoff.json keyed by actual IfcSpace GlobalIds. OpenStudio must consume stage2.ifc and the handoff, create three separate thermal zones with handed-off schedules, loads and outdoor air, dual-setpoint thermostats and ideal air loads, forward-translate result.osm to in.idf, and run a real annual EnergyPlus simulation. Deliver all stage artifacts, native_stage_log.json, workflow.osw, result.osm, in.idf, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, energy_report.csv, run\eplusout.sql, and run\eplusout.err. Preserve EW3B06 and workflow_spec.json tokens. Evaluation parses IFC entities, space geometry, quantities, properties and retained GlobalIds, reconciles Archicad live queries and handoff values, opens standard EnergyPlus SQLite tables, checks zone areas and nonzero simulated energy, and independently reruns EnergyPlus; hashes, tokens, or self-reported JSON alone do not pass.
